_what: The printed heading each mapped group's rows must sit beneath on Form 433-A. Read by adapters/pdf/verify-headings.mjs. Every `text` below is drawn on the page verbatim; the tool refuses to run if a string cannot be found on its declared page, which makes this file a second, independent pin on the revision.
_why: 433-A's fourteen groups are bound by field names that carry no meaning (p2_t23_14a[0]) and, on this form, are frequently out of printed order — real_property already binds Table_Line17b[1] BEFORE Table_Line17b[0] because that is the order the rows print in. Nothing proved that until now; it was authored by hand and believed. This file lets geometry state it.
_band_rule: Each heading owns the vertical band from its own printed baseline down to the next declared heading on the same page. A widget belongs to the band containing its rectangle's vertical centre. Headings are declared densely enough to bound every group — including headings no group claims (CASH ON HAND, BUSINESS CASH ON HAND, the Section rules), because an undeclared heading between two declared ones silently widens the band above it.

household_members.heading: HOUSEHOLD_MEMBERS
household_members._why: Line 2c's table. The caption above it is a sentence, not an all-caps banner; the declaration takes the printed text as it is rather than inventing a tidier one.

bank_accounts.heading: PERSONAL_BANK_ACCOUNTS
bank_accounts._why: Lines 13a-13d, under the PERSONAL BANK ACCOUNTS banner. The 13e total sits inside the same band.

digital_assets.heading: DIGITAL_ASSETS
digital_assets._why: The digital-asset table on page 3. Its internal name is Table_Line14de while its sibling investments table is Table_Line14 — one character apart, on different pages, under different headings.

life_insurance_policies.heading: LIFE_INSURANCE
life_insurance_policies._why: Line 16's three policy columns. This group's slots are COLUMNS of one printed block, not rows; they still all sit in one band.

real_property.heading: REAL_PROPERTY
real_property._why: Lines 18a-18c. The map binds Table_Line17b[1] as slot[1] and Table_Line17b[0] as slot[2] because that is the printed order; both are inside this band, so this check confirms the band, not the within-band order.

property_line_20.heading: PERSONAL_ASSETS
property_line_20._why: Lines 20a-20b. Internal names say Table_Line19a/Table_Line19b; the page says 20a/20b. The name is wrong and the band is right.

business_bank_accounts.heading: BUSINESS_BANK_ACCOUNTS
business_bank_accounts._why: Lines 65a-65b. Same printed caption family as the personal accounts on page 2 and a different band; only geometry separates them.
